answer: Grant each archive-agent key one daily vote for retaining a unique 1 GiB sealed replica of reef surveys, relic scans and sonnet manuscripts. Validators check key-bound replication proofs and timed random reads; failed or missing checks deny the vote. n keys must retain n GiB: no replica can back two keys. Disks are reusable capital; occupied capacity is the ongoing cost. Sound sealing and deadlines that defeat regeneration from shared originals are essential; otherwise aliases can reuse storage. Wealth still buys votes.
